en.summary: US Secretary of State Marco Rubio strongly condemned a Houthi attack on King Khalid International Airport in Riyadh that killed 12 people, including an American citizen, and stated that the United States supports Saudi Arabia.

en.summary: Coalition forces pledged a strong response to a Houthi attack on Riyadh's King Khalid International Airport that killed 12 people and injured over 300. U.S. President Trump and Secretary of State Rubio condemned the assault on Saudi aviation infrastructure.

en.summary: Global leaders and the UN Secretary-General have condemned a Houthi missile strike on Riyadh airport that caused 12 deaths and over 300 injuries, calling for increased protection of civilians and aviation infrastructure in Saudi Arabia.

en.summary: The Coalition to Support Legitimacy in Yemen characterized a Houthi attack on King Khalid International Airport in Riyadh as a war crime and vowed a firm response in accordance with international humanitarian law.

en.summary: An attack on King Khalid International Airport in Riyadh resulted in 12 deaths and 309 injuries, with victims from multiple countries. All injured individuals are receiving medical treatment at hospitals.

en.title: TASI: 23 stocks, 3 REITs fall to all-time lows

en.summary: Thirty-four companies listed on TASI and one REIT unit reached their lowest prices in 52 weeks on October 11. The affected securities showed declines ranging from 36% to 73% over the past year.

en.summary: The World Petroleum Congress opened in Riyadh on October 11 as part of Riyadh Energy Week. The event brings together global energy leaders and experts to discuss technological innovations and key issues in the energy sector.

en.title: Saudi IPI declines 23.5% in August
en.summary: Saudi Arabia's Industrial Production Index fell 23.5% year-over-year to 87.1 points in August 2026, driven by reduced output in mining and manufacturing activities. The index measures changes in production quantities across the economy.
